sources.title: SceneWorks/realvisxl-lightning-mlx · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pre-quantized, packed-load tiers of SG161222/RealVisXL_V5.0_Lightning for on-device Apple-Silicon inference with SceneWorks / mlx-gen (the sdxl generator). Each tier is a self-contained diffusers turnkey snapshot (U-Net + both CLIP text encoders + VAE + tokenizers + scheduler + model_index.json) that loads directly — no in-app quantization pass, no dense transient.
